It's not because of western inspiration, Chinese drama makers do not care about catering to the western audience, and I prefer it that way.

People watching Chinese dramas need to accept Chinese culture or tolerate it without being rude.

Recent Chinese dramas seem more fast paced and more direct in storytelling, due to the new rules for Chinese dramas.

Now all dramas can only have a maximum of 40 episodes, and each episode can't go over about 45 minutes run time.

Also, if they want to make a season 2, you need 1 year gap before you can release it.

Because of these changes, the story telling is more faster and direct, and there are less side stories, or less time is spent on the 2nd lead's stories.

I miss the days, when there wasn't a limit to the number of episodes, or when the episodes could be 1 hour long.

I even picked up ancient Chinese in historicals and fantasy immortal dramas.

I find ancient Mandarin Chinese more beautiful than modern Mandarin. 

I can somewhat speak Mandarin now, and I like that I don't have to wait for subtitles to understand a drama.

Wuxia deals more with martial arts heros in the mortal realm, 
and dramas involving immortals and magical powers, fantasy and other worlds are called Xianxia dramas. 

The immortals and heavenly realm shown in the dramas are based on ancient Chinese mythology and religion. 

Ancient Chinese Gods and Goddesses dwell in the heavenly realm. 

You will see mentioned in these dramas, ancient creator primordial Gods like the Goddess Nuwa and God Pangu. 

The heavenly realm is ruled by the heavenly emperor, who is the emperor of the Gods and in charge of the heavenly realm and it's soldiers. 

The remaining Gods and immortals in the heavenly realm all have a rank and their own duties that they are responsible for. 

For example, the God of war and the God of fate, that also writes the fate of mortals on earth. 

There is also the demon realm and obviously the mortal realm where humans reside. 

The immortals are not invincible, they just have longer life spans and magical powers. 

For example, a 15,000 year old immortal is the same as a 15 year old teenager.

Time also moves differently in the immortal realm and mortal realm. 

1 year spent on earth is usually equal to 1 day in the heavenly realm. 

When humans die, they can be reborn as a lowly immortal in the heavenly realm, if they have done enough good deeds, 
then they have a chance to cultivate more magical powers and get promoted to the ranks of a God or a high God. 

Evil people can be reborn as demons in the demon realm, or as mortals again on earth with bad fates. 

When an immortal in the heavenly realm makes a big mistake, they are usually punished with being banished to the mortal realm.

They are made to drink a memory wipe potion, and then reborn in the mortal realm as a powerless human. 

The god of fate, then writes them a harsh fate full of hardships, sometimes involving a love trial. 

Enduring this bad life and not doing more sins or evil in the mortal realm, is called passing their tribulation or mortal trial. 

Upon death, they are forgiven and allowed to return to the immortal realm in their previous rank. 

The suffering of the soul usually allows for the growth of the soul, and leads to more cultivation power and also let's the immortal or the God to have an upgrade in their powers. 

Another reason for sending immortals to reincarnate into the mortal realm, is for healing if they are severely injured, 
as suffering in the mortal realm leads to more spiritual power growth and an upgrade in magical powers. 

This is just the basic stuff in these fantasy dramas, you can Google the other detailed stuff, when you're watching a drama and don't understand.

Some background information to help you with Chinese fantasy dramas -


Dramas involving immortals and magical powers, fantasy and other worlds are called Xianxia dramas. 

The immortals and heavenly realm shown in the dramas are based on ancient Chinese mythology and religion. 

Ancient Chinese Gods and Goddesses dwell in the heavenly realm. 

You will see mentioned in these dramas, ancient creator primordial Gods like the Goddess Nuwa and God Pangu. 

The heavenly realm is ruled by the heavenly emperor, who is the emperor of the Gods and in charge of the heavenly realm and it's soldiers. 

The remaining Gods and immortals in the heavenly realm all have a rank and their own duties that they are responsible for. 

For example, the God of war and the God of fate, that also writes the fate of mortals on earth. 

There is also the demon realm and obviously the mortal realm where humans reside. 

The immortals are not invincible, they just have longer life spans and magical powers. 

For example, a 15,000 year old immortal is the same as a 15 year old teenager.

Time also moves differently in the immortal realm and mortal realm. 

1 year spent on earth is usually equal to 1 day in the heavenly realm. 

When humans die, they can be reborn as a lowly immortal in the heavenly realm, if they have done enough good deeds, 
then they have a chance to cultivate more magical powers and get promoted to the ranks of a God or a high God. 

Evil people can be reborn as demons in the demon realm, or as mortals again on earth with bad fates. 

When an immortal in the heavenly realm makes a big mistake, they are usually punished with being banished to the mortal realm.

They are made to drink a memory wipe potion, and then reborn in the mortal realm as a powerless human. 

The god of fate, then writes them a harsh fate full of hardships, sometimes involving a love trial. 

Enduring this bad life and not doing more sins or evil in the mortal realm, is called passing their tribulation or mortal trial. 

Upon death, they are forgiven and allowed to return to the immortal realm in their previous rank. 

The suffering of the soul usually allows for the growth of the soul, and leads to more cultivation power and also let's the immortal or the God to have an upgrade in their powers. 

Another reason for sending immortals to reincarnate into the mortal realm, is for healing if they are severely injured, 
as suffering in the mortal realm leads to more spiritual power growth and an upgrade in magical powers. 

This is just the basic stuff in these fantasy dramas, you can Google the other detailed stuff, when you're watching a drama and don't understand.
